references.text: Connects the geographical definition of the promised land in Genesis with the theological confirmation that this land is given as an inheritance to Abraham's descendants in Exodus.
Confirms the continuity of God's promise of the land from Abraham to Jacob, where 15:19 defines the area and 35:12 confirms it shall be given to his offspring.
Links the geographical definition of the promised land in Genesis to the practical call to take possession of this specific land in Deuteronomy.
Confirms that the land defined in Genesis 15:19 is the same land God confirmed to Moses in Deuteronomy 34:4.
